spells.name: OffoDefo
spells.description: A small mossy stone coalesces, jabs forward, then returns as protective stone plates.
notes: FX only, with no Wizard or Golem body.
Formation 0–3; hold 4–7; rightward jab 8–11; returning shield plates 12–15.
The shield follow-through belongs around the caster; any future scene playback should move that phase from the opponent back to the caster.
Current rule: deal 5 damage and gain 5 Shield;7+ gives 5 additional Shield. No mechanical changes.

spells.name: Bengal Shield
spells.description: Layered mossy stone slabs assemble into a broad shield; a tiny violet Mana glint appears before the stone-flake fade.
notes: FX only; compatible with either Wizard or Golem form.
Formation 0–3; clean shield hold 4–7; optional Mana flourish 8–11; disassembly 12–15.
Current rule: gain 10 Shield;6+ grants 1 Mana. The violet flourish is conditional in any future implementation.

spells.name: Earthbound
spells.description: A low ridge charges into a forward stone wave, then rises into a compact three-slab rampart.
notes: FX only, no caster body or fixed landscape.
Formation 0–3; hold 4–7; rightward ground wave 8–11; conditional rampart 12–15.
Current rule: deal 5 damage;7+ gains 12 Shield. Future playback attaches the conditional rampart to the caster.

spells.name: Merciful
spells.description: Three mossy stone fragments assemble around an empty caster space, orbit through eight distinct poses, then scatter and fade.
notes: FX only; compatible with both Wizard and Golem bodies.
Base spell grants 3 Shield. Persistence is eligible only on 6+.
On the qualifying result, fragments persist until the END OF THE OPPONENT’S NEXT TURN, not the end of the current turn.
Duration indicator for the current incoming-damage-bypasses-Shield rule, not the former Golem-protection mechanic.
Review-only animation must simulate expiry; no live-game timing is installed.

spells.name: Tectonic
spells.description: A detached stone-fist effect assembles, charges, slams into a travelling crack, then shatters into dust.
notes: FX only, with no complete Golem body.
Formation 0–3; hold 4–7; slam and travelling crack 8–11; shatter/fade 12–15.
Valid only while Golem is active; current rule deals 15 damage. This spell is separate from the automatic Golem end-turn strike.
